description: Before a large payment: confirm the instructions you were given are the ones the payee declared and endorsed from their own wallet, past the cooling period — not a fraudster's, a lookalike of an address you paid, or a change from where you paid them before. XRPL address or bank account (hashed on this computer). Signed ok / warn / stop. Costs 0.01 XRP platform fee + 0.1 XRP. Moves money: on mainnet pass yes=true only after the person you act for agrees.

account.description: Bank instructions: account number or IBAN (hashed here, never sent).

address.description: The XRPL address you were told to pay.

amount.description: What you intend to send (XRP, or --currency).

as.description: Practice market only: act as this party id.

contract.description: The deal this pays: the payee must be its seller.

cooling.description: Hours new instructions must have been endorsed (default 72, at least 24).

currency.description: CAPPZ or USD-tokenZ/1 (RLUSD), for an XRPL payment in a token.

demo.description: Use the practice market on this computer (nothing published, no real money).

network.description: Which market (default testnet). Validate on testnet, then use mainnet (real XRP).

payee.description: The payee's party id — from your contract or an earlier, trusted exchange, never from the message with the instructions.

routing.description: Bank instructions: routing number / sort code / BIC (hashed here, never sent).

tag.description: The destination tag you were told to use.

name: market_confirm-payee
